Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O Allah, guide me in this day to righteous deeds
And fulfill for me in it my needs and hopes

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ لَا يَحْتَاجُ إِلَى التَّفْسِيرِ وَالْسُؤَالِ
Translation: O You who needs no explanation or questioning

Arabic text: يَا عَالِمًا بِمَا فِيْ صُدُورِ العَالَمِيْنَ
Translation: O You who knows what is in the hearts of all beings

Arabic text: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ الطَّاهِرِينَ
Translation: Send blessings upon Muhammad and his pure family
